'''Conflux'''es are a family of non-stackable [[keyword]] [[buff]]s that make [[hit]]s apply an [[elemental ailment]], and allow ''all'' [[damage type]]s to contribute to the magnitude of that ailment. 

==Mechanics==
A Conflux allows hits to inflict a specific ailment without requiring a chance stat (e.g. {{c|mod|#% chance to Ignite}}) or a [[critical strike]]. Additionally, the ailment will be based on the total damage of the hit, from all combined damage types. 

For example, when the player with Igniting Conflux deals a hit with base damage of the following types:
* 200 Physical
* 50 Fire
* 100 Cold
* 150 Chaos
that hit will apply ignite with a DPS value based on the total 500 damage.

===Variants===
* '''Igniting Conflux''': causes all damage types to apply [[ignite]].
* '''Chilling Conflux''': causes all damage types to apply [[chill]].
* '''Shocking Conflux''': causes all damage types to apply [[shock]].
* '''Elemental Conflux''': combines all three Conflux effects into one and applies ignite, chill, and shock on hit. Note that [[freeze]] is not applied by Elemental Conflux.
* '''Scorching Conflux''': causes all damage types to apply [[scorch]].
* '''Brittle Conflux''': causes all damage types to inflict [[brittle]].
* '''Sapping Conflux''': causes all damage types to apply [[sap]].

==Sources==
===Passive skills===
The following [[passive skill]]s grant Conflux:
{{Query passive skills
|where = passive_skills.stat_text LIKE "%conflux%"
}}

===Unique items===
The following [[unique item]]s grant Conflux:
{{Drop enabled unique item table
|tables=item_stats
|join=items._pageID=item_stats._pageID
|where=item_stats.id LIKE "%Conflux%" OR items.stat_text LIKE "%Conflux%"
|large=1
|base_item=1
|level=1
|stat=1
}}

===Modifiers===
The following [[modifier]]s grant Conflux:
{{modifier table
|q_tables=spawn_weights
|q_join=mods._pageID=spawn_weights._pageID
|q_where = mods.stat_text LIKE "%Conflux%"
       AND mods.id NOT LIKE "%unique%"
|generation_type=1
|level=1
|stat_text=1
|spawn_weights=1
}}

}}

}}
